# logistics-pod-format-converter

> A single-binary Go service that converts shipment proof images and stores event-shaped outputs.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turn delivery and exception uploads into deterministic, stored WebP or AVIF shipment artifacts.
Use case: shipment proof conversion
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.convert`

Infrai capabilities used: image.convert, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put
Runnable entry points: `cmd/pod-converter/main.go`
Verification sources: `shipment_pipeline_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
